Task: Bulk Modulus of Aluminum
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of aluminum by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for aluminum. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10

- materials_project_id: mp-134

function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_3/in.elastic", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Al.data

# EAM potential for Al
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al_nist.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
change_box all triclinic

# Define variables
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable atomvolume equal vol/atoms
variable xx equal c_stress[1]
variable yy equal c_stress[2]
variable zz equal c_stress[3]
variable yz equal c_stress[4]
variable xz equal c_stress[5]
variable xy equal c_stress[6]

# Store initial box dimensions
variable tmp equal lx
variable lx0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal ly
variable ly0 equal ${tmp}
variable tmp equal lz
variable lz0 equal ${tmp}

# Define deformation matrix components
variable d1 equal ${up}
variable d2 equal -${d1}

displace_atoms all random 0.01 0.01 0.01 123456

# Calculate elastic constants
fix 3 all box/relax aniso 0.0

compute stress all stress/atom NULL
compute peratom all pe/atom
compute str all reduce sum c_stress[1] c_stress[2] c_stress[3] c_stress[4] c_stress[5] c_stress[6]

# Output
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz lx ly lz vol
thermo 1
thermo_modify format float %20.15g

# Apply strains
variable dir loop 6
  label loop

  # Reset box and coordinates
  clear
  box tilt large
  read_data Al.data
  
  # EAM potential
  pair_style eam/alloy
  pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al_nist.eam.alloy Al
  
  # Minimize
  minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
  
  # Impose deformation
  if "$dir == 1" then &
    "change_box all x delta 0 ${d1} remap units box"
  if "$dir == 2" then &
    "change_box all y delta 0 ${d1} remap units box"
  if "$dir == 3" then &
    "change_box all z delta 0 ${d1} remap units box"
  if "$dir == 4" then &
    "change_box all yz delta ${d1} remap units box"
  if "$dir == 5" then &
    "change_box all xz delta ${d1} remap units box"
  if "$dir == 6" then &
    "change_box all xy delta ${d1} remap units box"
    
  # Minimize after deformation
  minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
  
  # Output stress components
  print "Strain_${dir} ${d1}"
  print "Stress_xx ${xx}"
  print "Stress_yy ${yy}"
  print "Stress_zz ${zz}"
  print "Stress_yz ${yz}"
  print "Stress_xz ${xz}"
  print "Stress_xy ${xy}"
  print " "

next dir
jump in.elastic loop

print "All done""}

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Create aluminum FCC structure
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 4 0 4 0 4
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# EAM potential for Al
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Al_nist.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Output settings
thermo 1
thermo_style custom step pe press vol
thermo_modify format float %20.15g

# Store initial values
variable V0 equal vol
variable P0 equal press

# Apply hydrostatic compression
variable delta equal 0.000001
change_box all x scale $(1.0-${delta}) y scale $(1.0-${delta}) z scale $(1.0-${delta}) remap
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Get final values
variable V1 equal vol
variable P1 equal press

# Calculate bulk modulus (B = -V(dP/dV))
variable bulk_modulus equal -${V0}*(${P1}-${P0})/(${V1}-${V0})/10000 # Convert to GPa
print "Bulk_modulus_GPa = ${bulk_modulus}""}
